and one who gives [an animal to a gentile] in receivership, though he is not permitted -- they fine him up to ten times its value, and he gives all its value to the priest
and the Rabbis say: as long as the gentile's hand is in the middle, it is exempt from the firstborn law
here the case is one who gave a pregnant animal [to the gentile] to fatten: since we fine him for the animal, we fine him for the fetus

no -- [the baraita's prohibition of receivership is said] of the fetus
